description:
PR #876 test-refactoring review requested by the user on 2026-11-20. Reuse the existing SMTP/IMAP fixtures without losing connection-resolution coverage.

Sources: test/zaq/channels/outbound_connection_test.exs, "SMTP binding reuses the selected inbox while still validating the sender" and "email ingress lookup remains independent of its outbound SMTP binding".
Destination: test/zaq/channels/email_bridge_test.exs, "an IMAP-bound reply uses its explicitly linked SMTP account".

Reuse the destination's two SMTP connectors and linked IMAP connector. Add direct connection-resolution checks before sending: selected sender identity, sender-policy precedence (:abort even if ingress settings allow continuation), and QueryRecorder evidence that the SMTP row is read while the supplied IMAP row is not fetched again. Assert ingress lookup equivalence before and after disabling the bound SMTP connector; outbound resolution must then fail with delivery :not_sent.

Retain the destination's sender, audience, Message-ID domain, missing-binding, default-account non-substitution, and disabled-account assertions. Retire only the two absorbed source tests once all assertions/scenarios are mapped. Keep the Jido lookup compatibility test separate; do not remove its module wholesale.

Acceptance: preserve query-budget, policy, ingress/outbound independence, and selected-account contracts with fewer repeated fixture lines.
Validation: mix q and outbound_connection_test.exs plus email_bridge_test.exs. Final validation remains owned by zaq-1lw.13.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable to production operations; this is test-only consolidation using existing public contracts and fixtures. No production API or behavior changes.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md, and docs/conventions.md before implementation. This issue records the requested work; the user's request to create issues is not an implementation or broader test-behavior approval. Follow the existing-test-behavior gate for retiring tests; preserve assertions and map source coverage to its destination.

comments.text: User explicitly approved this exact SMTP consolidation in the current request. .29 isolated validation and mix q passed before starting .30. Action reuse not applicable to production: tests call existing EmailBridge/Bridge resolution, SMTP transport and QueryRecorder contracts. Reuse destination linked-account fixtures; move sender identity/policy and no-IMAP-refetch query checks plus ingress equivalence/outbound-disabled checks into destination before deleting the two source tests. Keep separate Jido lookup compatibility test and all destination delivery/missing/default/disabled assertions. No production changes, dependency changes, new property or E2E required; preserve existing property coverage.

Coverage mapped and destination verified before retirement: (1) selected SMTP id + stop policy + channel_configs query capture of SMTP/read and no IMAP/refetch -> linked-account test before send; (2) ingress equality to Bridge lookup before/after disabling bound SMTP + outbound Error.delivery:not_sent -> same test before send and after disabled update. Destination now explicitly sets SMTP send_on_file_failure:false and inbox:true to preserve policy-precedence scenario. Existing two-SMTP selection, envelope audience/from, Message-ID sender domain, missing binding, default non-substitution and disabled connector_mismatch assertions remain verbatim. Separate Jido compatibility source remains. Baseline82 PASS (1 property); moved destination plus still-present sources4 PASS before deleting sources. Logs /tmp/zaq-1lw-30-before.log and /tmp/zaq-1lw-30-moved.log.
